ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISPICKVAL(Gateway__c, "UAEDDS"),
OR( AND( ISCHANGED(Cancellation_Approved__c), Cancellation_Approved__c = TRUE ), AND( ISCHANGED(Cancellation_Initiated__c), Cancellation_Initiated__c = TRUE ) ),
